title: Window arithmetic
prompt: With left edge `l` and right edge `r` (both inclusive), the window length is…
explanation: Inclusive-inclusive ranges have length end - start + 1. Off-by-one here is THE most common sliding window bug.

title: Drill: max window sum
prompt: From memory: return the maximum sum of any contiguous window of exactly `k` elements (1 ≤ k ≤ nums.length). Build the first window, then slide with add-enter/subtract-leave.

solution.explanation: Initialize best with the FIRST window (not 0!) so all-negative arrays work.

hints: Sum the first k elements before the sliding loop.

title: Drill: shortest window with sum >= target
prompt: From memory (variable window): given positive `nums` and a `target`, return the length of the SHORTEST contiguous subarray whose sum is >= target, or 0 if none. Grow right, shrink left while the sum still qualifies.
hints: Add nums[r]; while sum >= target, record the length and shrink from the left.
